skills.name: Hand Signing
skills.summary: The ability to communicate using your hands.  This works as a simple test if targeting another namegiver who has the same skill, target number 5, and the signing can communicate complex mean. Whoever we needs a success equal to 20 minus the targets perception score on Tagets that do not have this skill.  So a target that does not know hand signing with a perception of 10 would require a 10 or greater to understand the intent of the hand signing, and you can only communicate simple ideas.

skills.name: Freezing Stare
skills.summary: The ability to stare down a target and freeze them, stopping them from moving.  Target the nagegivers social defence and if you succeed the target can not move from the stop or fight as long as you remain staring and not moving yourself.
